Hi all,

  please review this fix to the heap-too-large-for-representable-region-indexes issues in G1.

An alternative could be an arbitrary heap size limit below that value, but I went for just fixing the overflow.

There can be no positive test at the boundary, because apparently memory reservations above somewhere around 2 PB fail anyway.

Testing: gha, test case

Thanks,
  Thomas
